One table has a blue painted top, the other has a wood-grain laminate top
Both have cast iron legs, treadle wheels, foot pedals, and empty cutouts for machine heads
Photo 2 shows a measurement scale along the front edge of the blue top
Photo 3 shows a green electric motor sitting beside the wood-top table
No sewing machine heads are present on either table

Close-up of any brand name or plate on the cast iron frame
